integrity_statement: Analytic proof gives full containment and a finite John contact certificate for all dimensions and separations in scope. Numerical diagnostics are supporting checks, not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two congruent Euclidean balls with positive-volume intersection; no unequal-radius or many-ball formula. High-dimensional asymptotics require a fixed positive normalized separation. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Universal contact latitudes and exact John ellipsoids of symmetric two-ball lenses
